archetype_reasoning: Explicit user request to override standard bakery theme for the dashboard to match 'STRATEGIC CONFECTIONERY SYSTEM' holographic HUD reference.

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-black tracking-tighter uppercase text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-[#00F0FF] to-[#00B4D8]
hierarchy.h2: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#E0FBFC] uppercase
hierarchy.data_large: text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold font-mono tracking-tighter text-[#00F0FF] drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,240,255,0.4)]

layout_and_spacing.dashboard_wrapper: min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-[#02080B] to-[#031217] p-4 md:p-6 lg:p-8 overflow-hidden
layout_and_spacing.integration_note: Ensure dashboard container has its own background color to prevent the brown gradient from the sidebar bleeding into the HUD area. Use a crisp 1px border on the left side (border-l border-[#00F0FF]/20) to separate the HUD from the existing app's brown sidebar.
layout_and_spacing.grid_classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 lg:gap-6
layout_and_spacing.panel_classes: relative rounded-xl bg-[#041A25]/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-[#00F0FF]/15 p-5 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,240,255,0.03)] overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300

kpi_tiles.classes: flex flex-col justify-between h-full space-y-2 relative z-10

recharts.defs_required: <defs><linearGradient id='cyanGradient' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'><stop offset='5%' stopColor='#00F0FF' stopOpacity={0.8}/><stop offset='95%' stopColor='#00B4D8' stopOpacity={0.1}/></linearGradient></defs>

status_badges.base: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border uppercase tracking-wider font-mono

header_strip.classes: flex items-center justify-between mb-8 pb-4 border-b border-[#00F0FF]/20 relative
header_strip.title: text-2xl font-black tracking-widest text-[#00F0FF] uppercase drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,240,255,0.5)] flex items-center gap-3
header_strip.decoration: absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-1/3 h-[2px] bg-gradient-to-r from-[#00F0FF] to-transparent

micro_animations.glow_pulse: Use customized animate-pulse on key metrics with opacity shifting between 0.7 to 1.0 to simulate breathing HUD.
micro_animations.staggered_entrance: Use Framer Motion to stagger panel entrances: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.4, staggerChildren: 0.1 }}
micro_animations.tracing_beam: Add a subtle moving background gradient to the border of high-priority panels to simulate a scanning holographic interface.

technical_notes.data_testid: ALL interactive elements, KPI values, chart wrappers, and status badges MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='kpi-faturamento-value', data-testid='order-status-badge').
technical_notes.chart_responsiveness: Wrap all Recharts in <ResponsiveContainer> with aspect ratios or explicit heights (e.g., h-72) to ensure they expand properly inside the glass panels.
